notes: No job in this partition calls a PROC (no EXEC PROC= or bare EXEC X), so no proc steps were expanded and there are no step-to-proc call edges. app/proc/REPROC.prc and TRANREPT.prc are unused here.
app/jcl/FTPJCL.JCL: the job name on the JOB card is FTPJCLS (not FTPJCL), so ids are job:FTPJCLS and step:FTPJCLS.STEP1 (lines 1, 30). Step runs PGM=FTP, in-stream SYSIN (DD *) not parsed.

app/jcl/DEFCUST.jcl:22 and :32 both name a step STEP05; the second is step:DEFCUST.STEP05#2. Both are IDCAMS with control cards only (DELETE AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER, then DEFINE CLUSTER AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER), so no data edges.

app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL:90: garbled text after the SPACE parameter on the STMTFILE DD of STEP040 (stray '00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS'). It follows a blank so it is comment text on a continuation line; DSN is on line 91. STEP040 runs in-scope CBSTM03A so no step data edge is emitted anyway.

app/jcl/CBADMCDJ.jcl:27: STEP1 PGM=DFHCSDUP with PARM='CSD(READWRITE),PAGESIZE(60),NOCOMPAT' (continuation line 28). DFHCSD DD (line 30) is DISP=SHR so mode is read by the DISP rule, although the utility actually updates the CSD. Line 25 is a JCL SET statement, not a step. In-stream CSD definitions (lines 34-163) not parsed.
Steps with PGM=SDSF (CARDFILE CLCIFIL/OPCIFIL, CUSTFILE CLCIFIL/OPCIFIL, CLOSEFIL CLCIFIL) have only SYSOUT and in-stream ISFIN DDs, so no data edges. The CEMT commands in ISFIN are not parsed.

IDCAMS steps: only DD statements were used for data edges; REPRO, DEFINE and DELETE control cards in SYSIN were not read, so files IDCAMS creates or deletes through control cards (DEFINE CLUSTER, DEFINE GENERATIONDATAGROUP steps) have no data edges. Mode comes from DISP only, so REPRO output DDs with DISP=SHR or OLD (ACCTFILE.STEP15 ACCTVSAM, CARDFILE.STEP15 CARDVSAM, DISCGRP.STEP15 DISCVSAM, CREASTMT.STEP020 OUTFILE, and so on) show as read though they are really written.

DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE) DDs on IEFBR14 (CREASTMT.STEP030 lines 67 and 72; DUSRSECJ.PREDEL line 25; ESDSRRDS.PREDEL line 26) are labeled write because MOD gives write under the guide, although the effect is a delete.

Trailing (...) removed from DSNs: TRANSACT.BKUP(0), SYSTRAN(0), TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1), TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1), TRANCATG.PS.BKUP(+1), DISCGRP.BKUP(+1), and AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.JCL(INTRDRJ2) to ds:AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.JCL (INTRDRJ1.STEP01 line 17).
COMBTRAN.jcl:25 is an unnamed concatenated DD under SORTIN (DSN=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(0)); it gets its own read edge with evidence line 25.

INTRDRJ1.JCL:8-9 DSNs are spelled AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST and AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP (CARDEMO, missing D) in the source, kept as written. INTRDRJ1.STEP01 SYSUT2 DD SYSOUT=(A,INTRDR) is skipped as a SYSOUT DD. It submits INTRDRJ2 through the internal reader, but no job-to-job call edge is labeled because the guide defines job-level call edges only for PGM=, PROC, Control-M and shell submits.
Steps running in-scope programs get no data edges here: CBEXPORT.STEP02 (CBEXPORT), CBIMPORT.STEP01 (CBIMPORT), CREASTMT.STEP040 (CBSTM03A), INTCALC.STEP15 (CBACT04C, PARM='2022071800' at line 22).
DEFGDGD.jcl STEP20/40/60 are IEBGENER (ext) with SYSIN DUMMY, which is skipped. DUSRSECJ.jcl:34 and ESDSRRDS.jcl:35 SYSUT1 DD * data lines are not parsed.
Temporal edges treat COND=(0,NE) steps as ordinary executable steps (COND is not evaluated). Temporal evidence lists the EXEC line of the source step, then of the destination step.
ESDSRRDS.jcl has CRLF line endings; line numbers are unaffected.
Data edge evidence is the first line of the DD statement; the note field gives the DD name and DISP.
